description: Run Open WebUI (a full Ollama chat interface) in Docker on the remote. Uses host networking so it talks to your existing Ollama on 127.0.0.1:11434 with no Ollama reconfiguration; HOST=127.0.0.1 keeps it bound to the server's loopback (reached only over the SSH tunnel). Note: with host networking that loopback bind is enforced by the app honoring HOST, not by Docker. First launch: create an admin account in the browser.

steps.description: Verify Docker is installed (install Docker first if this fails).
Check Ollama is reachable on :11434 (Open WebUI connects to it).
steps.run: echo 'Ollama not detected on 127.0.0.1:11434 — install the AI Chat plugin or start Ollama. You can also set the URL inside Open WebUI later.'

steps.description: Start the Open WebUI container bound to loopback 127.0.0.1:3000 (host networking → reaches host Ollama). First run pulls a multi-GB image.
steps.run: docker rm -f open-webui 2>/dev/null || true; docker run -d --name open-webui --restart unless-stopped --network=host -e HOST=127.0.0.1 -e PORT=3000 -e OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434 -v open-webui:/app/backend/data ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:main

steps.description: Wait for Open WebUI to finish starting (database migrations on first run).
steps.run: for i in $(seq 1 90); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 2; done; echo 'Open WebUI is still starting — give it a moment, then open it.'

uninstall.description: Stop and remove the Open WebUI container.
Remove the Open WebUI data volume (accounts, chats, settings).
